title: Find the Subtasks That Did Not Execute
summary: For each task with subtasks numbered 1 through subtasks_count, return every (task, subtask) pair not present in the executed list.
outputFormat: Rows task_id, subtask_id for each missing pair.
edgeRules: A task with no executed rows lists all its subtasks.

examples.text: authored-reference: task 1 with 3 subtasks, executed (1,2) -> missing (1,1), (1,3).
